name: piitrade-videos
description: Repo-level scripts and tests. Backend, web (frontend), mobile and worker each keep their own dependencies; nothing is installed at the root.

scripts.migrate: docker compose run --rm --build --entrypoint npm backend run prisma:migrate
scripts.test: npm run test:root && npm run test:backend && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
